summary.short: Hangzhou municipal regulation in force from 1 May 2026 promoting the embodied intelligent robot industry. It sets government support for R&D, infrastructure, data, industry and public-sector use, and binds developers, providers and deployers to safety, ethics, data-security and standards duties and prohibitions on harmful products.
summary.long: Regulation adopted by the Hangzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee on 29 December 2025, approved by the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee on 26 March 2026, effective 1 May 2026 (Art. 50). It applies to activities promoting the embodied intelligent robot industry within the Hangzhou administrative area (Art. 2). Chapters 2 to 6 cover technology innovation (basic research, core components, open-source ecosystems, intellectual property), infrastructure (networks, computing power, public and training datasets, pilot bases, testing platforms), industry development (financial, talent, land and fund support, standards, statistics), application in public and industrial sectors (including government procurement and open scenarios), and safety management. Article 43 prohibits products or services that endanger national security, public safety, user safety or privacy, and monopolistic or unfair conduct; violations are pursued under other laws cited by reference, and no separate penalty is set out. Articles 44 and 45 require ethics principles and full-process data security and personal information protection systems. Article 47 requires assessment before new market-access measures. Article 48 calls for study of registration, certification and traceability, and provides for graded supervision and sandbox regulation.

relations.target_text: 中华人民共和国立法法 (Legislation Law of the PRC), Art. 81(1)
relations.note: Stated in the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee's approval decision, which cites Art. 81(1) of the Legislation Law as the basis for approving the regulation. The regulation itself names no other instrument as its legal basis.

evidence.provision: Zhejiang NPC Standing Committee approval decision (批准决定), preamble
evidence.quote: 根据《 中华人民共和国立法法》 第八十一条第一款规定

notes: No amends, repeals, implements, transposes or named cross-reference relations are stated. Art. 1 cites 'relevant laws and regulations' (有关法律、法规) and Arts. 42-47 refer to 'relevant' or 'national' laws, standards and rules without naming them; these are not coded as relations. Art. 43 refers to national security, personal information, product quality and consumer protection laws for liability and sets no penalty here. Arts. 47-48 concern market-access assessment, registration, certification, traceability, electronic fencing and sandbox regimes, framed as studies, exploration or future proposals rather than enacted rules. Dates are internally consistent: adopted 2025-12-29, approved 2026-03-26, promulgated 2026-04-02, effective 2026-05-01 (Art. 50). Target_instrument_id is blank because the Legislation Law is not in the registry.
